allot.text: Goodluck India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Committee Meeting held on August 24, 2026. the Bonus Committee of Board of Directors of the Goodluck India Limited ( the Company ) in its meeting held on today i.e., 24th August, 2026, has, approved, the Allotment Allotment of 6,64,77,018 (six crores sixty-four lakhs seventy-seven thousand and eighteen) equity shares of a face value of Rs. 2/- (Rupees two only) each, as bonus shares.
